description: This file defines the React context and hooks for managing search state within a SuperEditor plugin. It includes context creation, custom hook for context access, reducer for state updates, and a context provider component.

methods.name: useSuperSearchContext
methods.description: Custom hook that provides access to the SuperSearch context, throwing an error if used outside the provider.

methods.name: SuperSearchContextProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the search context to its children, managing state and event listeners.
